author: Temmycreative
title: Paid vector illustrator for Goosebumps-style hoodie print
content:
Looking for a vector illustrator (Paid)

Need an illustrator who can create an original 80s–90s Goosebumps-inspired Halloween design for a hoodie/T-shirt.

Requirements:
* One skeleton as the main character
* Punk/rock retro horror vibe
* Clean vector for screen printing (AI/SVG/EPS)
* Large back print (13” × 16”)
* Neon green, purple & orange palette
* Original artwork only (no tracing existing designs)

Please reply with your portfolio, turnaround time, and price. Contact: reply on the Threads post or DM @temmycreative_.

author: Kat
title: Paid B&W illustrations for short-story series
content:
Looking for a human artist for some small, paid illustration work.

NO AI ART. No AI tools. I want to pay an actual artist for actual art.

I’m writing a series of short stories, and as I finish each one, I’m planning to release them digitally for free. Eventually, they’ll all be compiled into a physical book, so I don’t need full cover designs for every individual story.

What I am looking for is a small black-and-white illustration for each story that gives “Scary Stories to Tell in the Dark”. Maybe a little less intricate, but I want that “I’ve seen flashes of this in my dreams” creepy feeling. Ideally an artist who can gently teach me how much they should be paid for each illustration. 12 stories planned. Artist would get credit as the artist/illustrator. Contact: DM @katinnnky on Threads.
